contract: Retained reports preserve original bytes and embedded historical paths. Identity/gzip entries have stored hashes; ZIP bundles have physical-file hashes and per-member original hashes. Aliases resolve retained former paths. Historical matrices may reference discarded routine reports; the catalog inventories retained evidence only.

retention.note: Retain summaries, important protocol counterexamples, representative timing/control pairs and calibration failures. Discard routine repeats; no duplicate local archives. Historical matrix references to discarded reports remain unchanged and can be recovered from Git.
